excluded.reason: SCRUM-28 is about order tracking showing any order to unauthenticated users — this is SCRUM-27's behaviour (order history/tracking), not language switching. Not relevant to SCRUM-26.
SCRUM-12 is about session token surviving logout — this is a session/security concern unrelated to language switching. Not relevant to SCRUM-26.
The two open bugs (SCRUM-28 and SCRUM-12) both touch behaviour outside this story (order tracking and session management respectively). Neither requires a confirmation test under SCRUM-26.
Language selection carries no security implications — it is a UI preference with no authentication, authorisation, or data-exposure surface. The story and its context imply no security requirement.
